semantics.actual: supplier-reported prompt_tokens and completion_tokens; sum every completed call, including resent history
semantics.preflight: conservative UTF-8 byte estimate, not exact model tokens
semantics.temporary_call_reservation: estimate + requested output limit, reconstructed, released on completion; not actual consumption
semantics.finalization_reservation: historical fixed 16000 + requested output; reconstructed decision headroom, not an additional model call
semantics.unknown: started without finished usage; null exact total, never substitute zero
semantics.historic_charge: max(estimated_input, actual_prompt) + actual_completion per completed call; kept for historical comparison only
semantics.supplier_total: not stored separately in the snapshots
